lynx_commit_note: stamped by the writer: the newest commit touching this folder when the manifest was written

input.note: procedural, no generated input (plan.md P4: the glass and paper stay procedural; operator pick: props parametric). Reference: art-breakdown.md row 1 (backlit glass table, bright white edge light, emissive frame strip, the glass blue comes from the paper material, not a tint), the Director review of 04fc311 (rim, legs and rails near-black as in lookdev/00-hero.jpg; style-block.json studio #0A0F18 is the only dark value in the block, so it is the dark metal base) and brushed aluminium feet and ledge.

mesh_acceptance.note: re-imported from final.glb: 1 mesh object, 4032 vertices, 7946 tris, 36 connected components (rim, ledge, strip, glass, corner caps, screws, apron, legs, feet, rails), 0 floaters (a floater is a component whose bounding box touches no other), 0 open edges (the single-sided glass plane); glass plane faces up: true, 166 x 76 cm at z 0.942 m; glass in its own slot frame_glass_placeholder_REPLACE_IN_UE

scale.note: 180.88 x 90.88 x 95 cm (x, y, z up) re-imported from final.glb; top surface z = 0.95 m; edge thickness 3 cm at the outer front edge (target 3.0, the lamp-agent C-clamp grip); pivot: floor centre, x,y centre 0, 0, feet at z = 0 m. Assumption: the 95 cm top is a Lynx choice and the 1.80 x 0.90 m outline the owner's (2026-10-24); the UE world scale of the table (W3.2) is still to be confirmed on Wolf.

finishing.note: finish: 768 bevelled hard edges, 85% smooth-shaded faces, baked atlas at 536.4 px/m from 1 CC0 scans; one UV set (1); 3 PBR PNGs (the atlas: base colour, normal, ORM, 2048 px, the largest 1136008 bytes), every file under 10 MB (largest 1601996 bytes); 3 material slots (frame_atlas, frame_edge_glow, frame_glass_placeholder_REPLACE_IN_UE); emissive slot frame_edge_glow on 96 faces; evidence framing check passes on 5 images (min silhouette margin 0.0625 of the image, rule 0.03); evidence rendered with Cycles on the CPU. Not claimed: any UE import.

materials: frame_atlas (one 2048 px baked atlas: the rim extrusion, legs and rails in dark anodised aluminium #262B33 worn bright (#B4BAC2) on its edges, the ledge, apron and feet in aluminium #C9CDD2, the corner caps and screws in steel #5A5F66)
frame_edge_glow (emissive edge strip #F4FAFF, emission strength 1.5 (glTF emissive_strength), 2 cm wide and 8 mm tall on the whole ledge; UE drives the intensity)
frame_glass_placeholder_REPLACE_IN_UE (placeholder plane, base #BFD8F0, alpha 0.15: UE replaces it with the procedural glass and paper)

bounds_cm.note: x,z ground plane, y up (glTF); length 180, depth 90, height 95

pivot: floor centre (x and y at the middle of the 1.80 x 0.90 m outline, z = 0 at the feet); the table stands +Y in the GLB (glTF Y-up), +Z in Blender
scale_reasoning: Table top surface at 95 cm (wolf-plan W3.2 starts there; R4 lets the owner change it). Outline 1.80 x 0.90 m, a long drafting light table (the owner chose about 180 x 90 cm on 2026-10-24, spark vr-hands-zoom; the first frame was 1.20 x 0.80). The top is 3 cm thick at the outer edge because lamp-agent's manifest says its C-clamp grips a 3 cm table edge; the apron under the top is inset 6 cm so the clamp finds a bare edge. The rim is 5 cm wide; the glass opening is 1.70 x 0.80 m with a 2 cm ledge, and the ledge carries the emissive strip (2 cm wide, 8 mm tall, its top 6 mm under the rim top, so the 45 degree camera sees it), so the glass panel is 1.66 x 0.76 m, recessed 0.8 cm below the rim top. The legs stand 8.5 cm in from the sides and, along the length, 8.5 cm in at 1.20 m and further in as the top grows (15 cm at 1.80 m).
textures: frame_atlas_{basecolor,orm,normal}.png: one 2048 px atlas (ORM: R occlusion, G roughness, B metal; normal tangent-space OpenGL), baked with Cycles on the CPU from layered bake sources (scripts/art/lib/finish.bpy): Poly Haven CC0 scans tinted to the palette, curvature edge wear, grunge, AO (multiplied into basecolor at 0.55 too: the forward-shaded UE scene has no runtime AO). One unique UV set, long rails cut into 35 cm islands, hidden faces shrunk to 0.12; 536.4 px/m on the visible surface (2.378 m2). The GLB embeds the atlas as quality-92 JPEG (the 2048 px PNG set would put it over 10 MB). The glow and glass slots are flat colours with no texture.

finish.bevel: angle-limited bevel on every part's hard edges (rim 1.5 mm, legs 1.2 mm, caps 0.8 mm), 2 segments, arc miter, hardened normals, then weighted normals and smooth shading; 768 hard edges bevelled, 680 kept sharp by design (the glow strip, screw heads), 0 convex edges of 60 degrees or more left unrounded
finish.parts: rim: a 5 x 3 cm extrusion profile with a 6 x 3.5 mm groove on its outer face, swept round the outline with mitred corners; 2.5 mm steel corner caps with two screw heads per arm; 4 cm square extrusion legs with a groove down each face, levelling feet

blender: Blender 5.2.2, scripts/art/light-table-frame/build_frame.bpy (build and score), render_frame.bpy (evidence and framing check), write_manifest.mjs
licence: own procedural work; no generated input, no Leonardo, ComfyUI or TRELLIS; bake inputs are Poly Haven CC0 scans (blue_metal_plate (https://polyhaven.com/a/blue_metal_plate, CC0 1.0 (Poly Haven, https://polyhaven.com/license), 2.5 m tile)), never shipped as files
